description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.45 or 1.05 each), grants [Fire Radiant Shield: 75%] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire] and [Magic Sniper Mode] to the user

description.name: Fire Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Fire damage capped at 9999

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Magic Sniper Mode
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using a Fire ability
